question: On what scriptural authority should the desirous one accept this teaching?
premises: This has been said in the Sarasvatī Tantra.
The addressee is urged to know this.
inference: Because it is stated in the Sarasvatī Tantra, the desirous one should accept it as known.
plain_english: It is said in the Sarasvatī Tantra; therefore know this, O desirous one.
